integrity: Local probabilities are reconstructed from the documented 2026 prime-local theorem; the new simultaneous total-variation bound and asymptotic consequences are proved in RESULT.md. Finite exact checks are independent corroboration, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Unconditional joint law for degree-truncated differential-residue indicators only. It does not establish a distribution or criterion for positive orthogonal multiplicity; it does not control all prime degrees. Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible original 1998 literature and possible general polynomial-sieve implications.
title: A mesoscopic Gaussian law for residue obstructions in binary polynomial rings
